facts.text: Radar ray tracing can capture multipath sensing artifacts, but requires material parameters; the cited evidence is from road vehicles.
facts.quote: Radar ray tracing captures multipath ("Fourier tracing ... can model multipath related sensing artifacts") but needs material parameters **Independent (on-road evidence)** [32].

facts.text: Radar backscatter from wet and snow-covered surfaces has been measured at 77 GHz.
facts.quote: Radar backscatter from wet and snow-covered surfaces has been measured at 77 GHz [44].

facts.text: The RadaRays wheel-loader experiment is identified as the strongest direct off-road evidence for simulating cluttered or reflective surroundings.
facts.quote: The RadaRays wheel-loader experiment is the strongest direct off-road evidence

facts.text: In the RadaRays wheel-loader experiment, thin metal pillars in a hall were highly reflective, while walls behaved differently.
facts.quote: thin metal pillars in a hall were highly reflective while walls behaved differently

facts.text: In the RadaRays wheel-loader experiment, the synthetic image closely resembled reality after geometry was hand-built and materials were tuned.
facts.quote: after hand-building the geometry and tuning materials the synthetic image closely resembled reality

facts.text: Some real double reflections remained absent from the simulation in the RadaRays wheel-loader experiment.
facts.quote: but some real double reflections remained absent **Independent** [31]

facts.text: Validated simulation of material piles, highwalls, large steel structures, and the machine's own body causing self-reflection was not found for any sensor.
facts.quote: Material piles, highwalls, large steel structures and the machine's own body (self-reflection) were not found validated in simulation for any sensor.

facts.text: Field studies report that lidar on wet ground loses returns through specular reflection and creates mirror points.
facts.quote: Lidar on wet ground loses returns through specular reflection and creates mirror points; this is reported in field studies

facts.text: Validated simulation of lidar's lost returns and mirror points caused by specular reflection on wet ground was not found.
facts.quote: Lidar on wet ground loses returns through specular reflection and creates mirror points; this is reported in field studies, but validated simulation was not found.

facts.text: Lidar reflectance, specular and wet surfaces, and missed returns can be represented in simulation, but material and intensity calibration is demanding.
facts.quote: Lidar reflectance, specular and wet surfaces and missed returns can be represented, but material and intensity calibration is demanding.
